page.layout: One printed page, single column, centred verse and text. Running head centred at top. Page number 47 at top right. Below the text, the signature "N 2" at bottom right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Hoc te Gualtheri donauit Regula, corpus Cùm sacra baptismi tingeret vndatuum. Viue puer, tantiq; tene vestigia patris, Altera Vermiliæ spesq; decusq; domus. Sancta Spei coniuncta Fides tibi cuncta secundent, Flagret & æthereo pectus Amore Dei. Vnica mortalis sit CHRISTVS regula vitæ, Ancora qui pariter certa salutis erit.
main_text.head: IN LIBROS D. P. MARTYRIS IOANNIS FABRICII MONTANI.
Libri loquuntur.
main_text.p: Si præsens animi latentis index Est oratio, sicut eruditus Rerum nos docuit magister vsus. Si morum documenta sunt libelli, Nostro nil melius probatiusue, Dum vixit, potuit parente fingi, Nil disertius, eruditiusue, Nobis nam genitis parente tanto, (Verum dicere siquidem licebit) Nil syncerius est probatiusq;, Nil politius, elegantiusq;, Nil illustrius explicatiusq;. I nunc liuor edax tuumq; rode Et cor, & digitos, & omne quicquid Infelix rabies vorare suadet. Mirum ni tibi plaudis & triumphas, Inuictus quia miles iste Christi Nunc vitus[?] iacet, & iacet sepultus.

page.notes: The "Vnica" and "Viue" lines use v for u/i as printed; converted per rule 5. "vitus" in the last line of the poem carries a mark over the u that I cannot read with certainty; given as printed with [?]. A small pencil-like mark "1" at the left of the "Vnica" line is not printed text and is left out. Faint show-through from the reverse side is ignored.
